Name: Announcer
Dialog: Please welcome today's lecturer, psychologist Dr. Mosley Shamai.

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: Esteemed colleagues, tonight, I make history. (He spreads his arms wide making the glass of water crash off the podium.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I told you, my therapist is giving a talk!

Name: Linda
Dialog: I'm so glad you're talking to someone about this. It's all—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, it's already started!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh!

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: We've all heard our clients' claims of bizarre sightings across the Tri-State Area. UFOs, giant treehouse robots, and whatever this is.

Name: Man in audience 1
Dialog: The Giant Floating Baby Head lives! (he opens his jacket to reveal a baby head T-shirt underneath as a security guard drags him away. He lifts his shirt up to reveal a Klimpaloon tattoo.) And so does Klimpaloon, the Magical Old-Timey Bathing Suit Who Lives in the Himalayas!

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: Stories like his. Why is it that all of our patients believe these impossible claims? I believe I've found the answer. I present to you two clients, (Silhouettes of Doof and Candace appear on screen with red question marks over them) two complete strangers who seem to share the strange delusion. Or do they? Client one... (He changes the screen to show Candace with her eyes blacked out) a teenage girl convinced that her brothers are time-traveling space voyagers who build elaborate inventions that mysteriously disappear each day.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (chuckles)

Name: Linda
Dialog: (rummaging through her purse) Now where is that lip balm? What did I miss?

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: Client two, (flips to a picture of Doof with his eyes also blacked out) a self-proclaimed evil scientist whose inventions also disappear each day, allegedly due to a crime-fighting semiaquatic mammal in a fedora.

Name: Man in audience 2
Dialog: What?

Name: Man in audience 3
Dialog: Scoff!

Name: Woman in audience
Dialog: Show us.

Name: Man in audience 4
Dialog: (nickers like a horse) Uh-huh.

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: (laughs) Yes, I know. These bizarre claims sound like the ridiculous plot of a children's cartoon.

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: But behind this curtain is weeks of research that will expose the truth!

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: (laughs) They'll see! They'll all see! And to think it only started four weeks ago.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: ...and once again, just as I was about to take over the Tri-State Area, Perry the Platypus hits the self-destruct button, foiling my evil scheme.

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: Clearly a symbol for your self-destructive behavior. And the platypus, an obvious metaphor for whatever's keeping you down.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm not speaking metaphorically. Perry the Platypus actually came in wearing his little fedora and destroyed my inator every single day last sum—Hold on, I think I'm having a breakthrough! I think maybe—

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: That's time! We'll pick this up next week. Bye-bye.

Name: Candace
Dialog: ...and once again, just as I was about to show my mom, some Mysterious Force took the Rollercoaster away, foiling my epic bust!

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: Sounds like classic self-sabotage. And a rollercoaster, hmph, an obvious metaphor for life's ups and downs.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm not speaking metaphorically! The boys' inventions disappeared every single day last summer! And, of course, Mom never sees it! It's always, "Who wants pie? Oh, there you are, Perry."

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: Wait. Who's Perry?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Perry, our pet platypus. Come on, Doc. Keep up.

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: Hmmm. Tell me more.

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: Hmmm, disappearing inventions? A platypus? Something oddly specific is going on here. And where is this "Perry"?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (on watch) Agent P, the shower entrance only opens on ice cold.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (laughs) Agent P, the cold shower is the oldest prank in the book!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Good one, sir. Classic!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (laughs, clears throat) Agent P, we've learned that Doofenshmirtz may be in therapy. And if so, we fully support him and hope he gets the help he needs. But, on the other hand, if this doctor he's seeing is just another evil scientist, stop them at all costs.

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: I need more context on these patients, so I'm conducting interviews at their places of residence.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yeah, yesterday was the giant mechanical squid on roller skates, and today, we were gonna make a Bread Bowl Hot Tub, but here you are.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, perhaps they get it from me. I'm a bit of a tinkerer myself.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yeah, Phineas is a genius.

Name: Linda
Dialog: No, Doctor, I never see anything.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I ain't talkin' ta no shrinks!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: From my observations, Candace's instability stems from her desperate need for attention, which she clearly is not getting from her mother. It is no wonder Candace is crying out for help.

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: (voiceover) It seems each of them had a different grasp on reality. The data was inconclusive. I still needed more proof to validate my theory.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Come in.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uph! Oh, I'm sorry, that trap was meant for Perry the Platypus.

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: Sure, sure, sure, sure, sure. I was wondering, though, Heinz, is it possible to see one of your so-called "inators"?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You betcha! Y'know, y'know, I really took our last session to heart, so I built a very special inator. Behold! The self-destructing-self-destruct-inator! Designed to self-destruct the self-destruct button. A symbolic act of confronting my self-destructive behaviors. I know, it's a little on the nose.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus, you made it! (to Dr. Shamai) I-I-I-I hope you don't mind I asked my nemesis to join our session.

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: (voiceover) That's when I found out that the platypus was real!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You know we can hear you, right? I mean, we're standing right here.

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: Oh, I was talking about another patient and another platypus. Not you.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Great. (Gives scripts to Norm and Vanessa) I thought we could try a little role-playing exercise. Perry the Platypus, you be me. (to his own reflection) Me, you be Perry the Platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Come on, commit to the bit. Here, like this. (He kneels down and puts on a fedora.) "Oh, Dr. Doofenshmirtz, you're so evil. How can I ever thwart you?"

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, oh, right, right, you don't talk. Here, here, I'll help you. (grabs Perry's bill and makes it seem like he is talking) "Ah, Perry the Platypus, what an unexpected..." Well, I am really gonna have to carry this whole show, aren't I? Anyway, normally, it looks like this.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Vanessa, your line.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: "Whatever, Dad. Exit stage left."

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: One small note, sweetie. You don't have to read the stage direction. Anyway, you get the idea. Kick here, punch here, bada boom, bada bing. Oh, no! Look out! He body-slammed me into my self-destruct-inator!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Y'know, I never really know where these beams go, but I... I like to think it's a Mysterious Force for evil doing something bad to someone somewhere.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dr. Shamai, you said to call when it's happening. It's happening! The Mysterious Force just zapped the boys' invention and it disappeared!

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: Disappeared? Just now?!

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: (voiceover) Incredible! The same moment Client 2 claimed his inator-ray fired, Client 1 claimed that her brother's invention disappeared! By Jupiter! Is this a case of visceral psychosis? Could this actually be real? Finally, it all made sense! Although these two subjects had no contact with each other, their stories, in fact, were connected! This is the discovery of a lifetime! And tomorrow night, with my patient's permission of course, I will reveal the astounding truth of Danville's Mysterious Force! (laughs crazily)

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: Client 1 even told me her brothers are making a flying disco blimp tonight!

Name: Candace
Dialog: We're gonna bust Phineas and Ferb once and for all! (laughs)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Sorry, just ran to the bathroom. What'd I miss this time?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: And how is this supposed to expunge my childhood fear of the boogeyman?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Ya just gotta out-boogie the man!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, guys, time for the musical dance sequence!

Name: Buford
Dialog: My sequins are already dancin'.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hit the outside projector, Ferb, so all of Danville can join in!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, Code Red! Doof's therapist is about to blow the lid off of OWCA's entire operation, exposing us all! You must stop him! (to Carl) Keep shredding, Carl!

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: The question at hand, is this all a delusion or could it all be true?

Name: Candace
Dialog: This is my moment! Woo-hoo! This is about meeeeeee!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Omigosh, I never realized that. Okay, bye. (takes out earbuds) Sorry, honey. Your dad called with an antique emergency.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: He was so impressed with my inator, it seems a shame not to have it here for the presentation.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the—WHOA!

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: On this stage is weeks of research that will change the course of psychology forever!

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: Curtains, please.

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: Yes, hold your applause...

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: ...as you bask in my brilliance!

Name: Man in audience 5
Dialog: I don't think so!

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: What?! My research! My proof! It was all here! (to Perry) What are you doing here? Where's your fedora?! (to audience, trying to make Perry stand up) He can walk! Look!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We got to abandon ship!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Good thing we're all wearing parachute pants.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Time to get down.

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: My proof! Oh, my beautiful proof! What happened to my... (gasps) Wait. The disco blimp! It's real! It's all real!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes, yes, YES!!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, my things.

Name: Man in audience 6
Dialog: Oh, my briefcase!

Name: Woman in audience 2
Dialog: Oh, my purse!

Name: Man in audience 7
Dialog: Oh, my satchel!

Name: Man in audience 8
Dialog: My valise!

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: Look up! Forget what you dropped! Look behind you!

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: (screams)

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: But, but, but, but, but, but, but...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sighs) Tell me about it, Doc.

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: Wait a minute. Is it true or is it... Did I just imagine all of this? (unhinged) Do any of these people even exist?!

Name: Dr. Shamai
Dialog: Do I even exist?! Am I the delusional one?! Or am I just the delusion?!?! (A screen descends from the stage saying "Delusional".) STUDY MEEEEE!!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, perhaps we should get you a different therapist, one that won't get dragged offstage in a public meltdown. That was a lot. Are you okay, honey?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay? Mom, I feel great! What Dr. Shamai went through just once completely broke him! I go through that every day! (gasps) And look at me! I'm doing just fine!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Mmm, I'm so happy to hear that.
